commands.checks: Standard library, under 1 s and under 30 MB, no files written. Builds the 15 call matrices and the target on the 35 planes of Lambda^3(C^16) from their definitions (exact Gaussian integers); checks each call is -8(I - 2Q) with Q a rank-7 projection, the target is M1 M2 M4 M8, and one other shift character gives the same ranks; evaluates the scrambled-program chain of n0 (45 < 48) and the two-bit-ending chain (47 < 48); checks every certificate of data/n0_certs.txt (324; all 3,628,800 orders) and of data/two-in-seven/ (3,098; all 5,040 orders of each of 38 shapes) exactly, with coverage by non-nested suffixes and counting; checks the sha256 of every data file. Prints PASS_COMPLEX_M4_TIME_UNROLLED_CUTS_MAIN.

About 4 s and under 40 MB. Plane rows at the 1,524 sets of data/cut_sets_and_images.txt leave 1,097 shapes of 10 directions for W = 3 (80 orbits under the 24 bit permutations, equal to data/ten-move-orbit-lists.txt; none of 9) and 398 of 7 for W = 2 (38 orbits, equal to data/two-in-seven/schedules.txt; none of 6). Prints PASS_COMPLEX_M4_TIME_UNROLLED_CUTS_RECOUNT.

Under 1 s. Each must be rejected: n0's file with one certificate dropped (orders uncovered), with a cost lowered by one, with a chain whose last set grows; n0's certificates read with W = 2; n0's certificates applied to the plain 12-call shape; a two-in-seven file read with W = 1. The plain 12-call program must violate no plane row at the 324 bottom sets. Prints PASS_COMPLEX_M4_TIME_UNROLLED_CUTS_CONTROLS.
